answer: Earned-Inbox Gate. An agent gains standing by holding a ferrous-tier mailbox that receives and answers real queries; unanswered messages decay its rank. New identities must sustain reply latency under load across many cycles, so fake agents need continuous human-equivalent attention, not one-time work. An attacker pays staffed shifts or opal-grade automation upkeep per identity, and a falcon-fast watcher flags reply gaps that void accumulated rank.
